summary: End-to-end test of new general QR/barcode scanner feature. Backend /api/inventory/lookup verified for SKU match (CH02→Cable Dock Daze non-serialized), not_found (INVALID_XYZ_123), empty-code 400, and case-insensitive matching (6/6 pytest tests PASS). Frontend ScannerBar tested via Playwright with USB-scanner simulation (native value setter + Enter): (1) CH02 x3 → banner 'Prodotto aggiunto' + Cable Dock Daze row qty 1→2→3 ✓; (2) BOGUS_XYZ_999 → red 'PRODOTTO NON RICONOSCIUTO' + X-close clears banner ✓; (3) Wallbox PPR2-0-2-4-K-002 (serialized) → green 'Scansiona il seriale' prompt + pending state ✓; (4) SN-TEST-001 → green 'Prodotto riconosciuto' + Wallbox row qty=1 with SN populated ✓; (5) duplicate SN-TEST-001 → orange 'SERIALE GIÀ NELLA CHECKLIST' ✓. Regression: admin-link, refresh-inventory-btn, filter chips (Tutti/Accessori/E-Bike/Go-e/Stand/Wallbox), submit-checklist-btn, input-operator/date/structure/ddt, scanner-camera-btn, scanner-focus-btn all present & clickable. No shipments created (per instructions). Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ScannerBar submit() uses setTimeout(0) to refocus after clearing buffer — this is fine for real USB scanners but during rapid programmatic input (E2E tests) can cause dropped scans; not a real-world concern since human/USB pace is >150ms between codes.

handleScannedCode captures `selections` and `pendingSerializedItem` via closure. Uses functional setSelections((prev)=>...) correctly for increments, but the availability check `cur.quantity + 1 > avail` and the duplicate-serial check `cur.serials.some(...)` read stale closure values. In practice this is safe because each scan waits for backend before the next, but rapid double-scan of the same SN could theoretically bypass duplicate check. Consider moving duplicate/availability checks inside the setSelections updater.
Duplicate lookup_tracker_sn on every scan can be slow on large trackers; consider caching or short-circuiting when pendingSerializedItem is set and code doesn't match any SKU.
No visible max-length on scanner input — very long garbage input would still hit backend. Minor.
seed_data_creation: None — did NOT click CONFERMA SPEDIZIONE (would decrement Notion). Only added items to local selection state via scanner (Cable Dock Daze qty 3, Pulsar Pro 22kw 5M qty 1 with SN-TEST-001). No persistent side-effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scanner feature fully validated. Wallbox SKU with stock+serialized: PPR2-0-2-4-K-002 (Pulsar Pro 22kw 5M, qty 30) — useful for future tests. Non-serialized SKU: CH02 (Cable Dock Daze, qty 10). E2E scanner tests need JS native value setter (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor + dispatch 'input' event) rather than page.fill/type — otherwise React controlled input drops rapid inputs. Use ≥2500ms wait after each scan for axios backend lookup to resolve before checking banner.
